summary: Easy!Appointments: a CodeIgniter PHP online appointment-scheduling app (providers/secretaries/admins/customers as role-tagged users, bookable services, appointments with status, unavailabilities, blocked periods and working-plan exceptions on the appointments/user tables, plus a settings key-value store, consent records, webhooks, and Google/CalDAV calendar sync). CRUD surfaces: public booking flow, back-office CRUD controllers, and a token-gated REST API.
